# Alt written 12 Aug 2026 from contact sheets 01 and 02, plus the direct
# render of index 1 made when verifying the sheet-to-worklist mapping.
# SIX of Prithvi's eight photographs are here. Indices 1 and 2,
# /images/Project_Images/Prithvi/DSC_0091.jpeg and DSC_0093.jpeg, are
# deliberately NOT migrated — see IMAGE-ROLLOUT-STATUS.md. Both show a
# small blue-and-gold roadside temple at the foot of the rock cutting,
# with saffron flags and a shuttered row behind. Both are captioned
# "Prithvi — exterior of the building". Third and fourth instances of the
# same problem as Shaurya's gram panchayat office and Ishaan's college
# gate, and the same reason for leaving them: whether the gallery is for
# the building or for its neighbourhood is a content decision.
# §4 is explicit that Prithvi has NO rooftop solar — removed 11 Aug 2026 —
# so nothing here describes a panel. Nothing here names the single lift or
# the rooftop terrace either: neither is visible in any of these frames.
# Prithvi is under construction and pre-launch, so the frame, the netting
# and the stacked materials are current fact, not a §6.7 problem.
